# CANDIDATE: PUT_CALL_PCR_FADE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Intraday 0DTE put/call volume ratio below 0.4 indicates excessive call buying, creating a contrarian long bias when price is above VWAP and the EMA ribbon is bullish. This setup aims to capture mean-reversion in options flow when speculative call buying reaches extremes, aligned with intraday bullish price structure.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When the 5‑minute 0DTE put/call ratio (PCR) falls below 0.4, price is above the intraday VWAP, and the EMA ribbon (9‑EMA > 20‑EMA > 50‑EMA) is aligned bullish, enter long at the close of that bar. Exit shape: Initial stop placed at the bar's low or the prior swing low, whichever is lower; take profit 1 at 1.5× risk; runner trailed with a 12‑% chandelier exit from the highest high since entry. Regime hint: Best in low‑to‑moderate volatility (VIX < 20) and during the morning session (09:30‑11:30 ET) when flow data is most reliable; avoid during major news windows.
